title: Charter delegation: 4-layer model and issuance conditions
summary: Charter delegation is a 4-layer model: registry registration → exact grant match → envelope gate → execution reservation.
hint_triggers: Approval-required actions delegate via accountability charter only when: (1) the operation is registered in EXTERNAL_OPERATION_DELEGATION; (2) envelope.external_operations grant exactly matches the built target (repo+branch+visibility for VCS); (3) the gate evaluates envelope/appetite/availability/tripwires and the policy is charter-eligible (never mandatoryApproval, runtime floors, dual_key); (4) the durable execution reservation still applies after allow. external_operations grants require owner/officer authority_basis with evidence_ref; person-scope charter I/O runs only inside withInstalledPersonCharterRuntime binding; real CLI delegation requires an installed onboarding runtime (active member + NHI).
